name: Big Bang Duel
status: Publicly available at duel.hugoviegas.dev with guest access for an immediate AI/solo experience and Google sign-in for returning players.
summary: A fast browser-based strategy duel game that invites visitors to try a solo experience immediately as a guest, while offering a straightforward Google sign-in path for returning players.
hugoRole: Designed and built the product experience for a public-facing strategy game.
Worked across the front-end experience, game flow, player identity journey, and the product decisions that kept the game approachable for first-time visitors.
Shaped the public story around guest access, AI/solo play, and a clear path from trying the game to continuing with a player account.
userProblem: Visitors needed a low-friction way to understand the game before committing to an account journey.
The game needed a clear starting path that felt approachable and understandable to new players.
Returning players wanted a smoother option than starting from zero every time.
playerExperience: Players can open the full game and try the core duel experience quickly.
Guest access is positioned as the easiest starting point for an AI/solo session.
The flow is designed to help visitors understand the game without requiring a heavy commitment upfront.
guestVsAiExperience: Guest entry is intentionally the quickest way to try the game and experience the solo/AI mode.
The AI/solo route is meant to lower the barrier to first use while keeping the account path clear for returning players.
This does not overstate multiplayer, rankings, permanent purchases, or unrestricted cloud progression.
accountJourney: The account journey is presented as a practical step for returning players who want a more consistent experience.
Google sign-in is the high-level recurring-player option, but the public story stays focused on convenience and familiarity.
The experience keeps the product messaging clear: guest entry is for immediate tryout, while the account path supports a returning player journey.
challenges: Keeping fast game interactions responsive while maintaining a smooth duel experience.
Managing player identity and guest access without overstating what is available to each type of visitor.
Separating real-time game concerns from player-profile and progression concerns so the platform stays understandable and maintainable.
Making the game feel frictionless for first-time players while preserving a clear and practical long-term journey.
demonstrableCapabilities: Interactive strategy duel gameplay available in a browser at duel.hugoviegas.dev.
Guest access for immediate AI/solo play.
Google sign-in route for returning players.
A clear game-first experience designed around ease of entry and product clarity.
approvedClaims: Big Bang Duel is a browser-based strategy duel game available publicly at duel.hugoviegas.dev.
Guest entry makes it easy to start a solo/AI game immediately.
Google sign-in supports a returning-player path.
Hugo worked on the public-facing product experience and product decisions around accessibility, identity flow, and gameplay clarity.
The project uses React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Firebase Realtime Database at a high level.
The project is positioned as a frictionless entry experience for visitors who want to try the game quickly.
prohibitedClaims: Do not expose source code, Firebase configuration values, project identifiers, credentials, internal endpoints, database structures, security rules, or implementation secrets.
Do not claim guest users can access multiplayer, rankings, permanent purchases, unrestricted cloud progression, or unreleased features.
Do not invent metrics, active-player numbers, revenue, downloads, or launch dates that are not approved.
Do not describe the guest path as permanent account access or a full multiplayer system.
Do not present raw internal data or user records as public product information.

responseStyle.audience: Use understandable language for non-technical visitors and answer in the same language as the user asks.
responseStyle.priority: Answer the visitor's practical question first. Keep explanations concise, product-focused, and factual.

faq.answer: The public game is available at duel.hugoviegas.dev.
